title: Design System: DPDP Pipeline Live Flow

inter.stack: "Inter", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif
inter.role: Every word and figure. Embedded as a variable latin WOFF2 (weights 100-900, OFL, tools/portal_v2/fonts/) with font-display: block; weights used 400, 550, 600, 650, 700; font-feature-settings "cv11", "ss01", "tnum" on body.

mono.stack: "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, "SF Mono", Menlo, ui-monospace, monospace
mono.role: Identifier chips only (platform face, not embedded).

rootScale.purpose: Every size is rem off this root: about 16px at 1366 wide, 19.5px at 1920.

typographyMeta.exception: Inter is a user-approved exception (2026-10-11) to the Portal brief's no-web-fonts rule; the file stays single and offline.

shadows.name: current-divider
shadows.purpose: The pipe divider the values are crossing.

shadows.name: active-briefing
shadows.purpose: The active briefing option, over a pink 38%-22% gradient.

shadows.name: next-key-lift
shadows.purpose: The Next key, the one control pressed every step.

shadows.name: stepper-fill
shadows.purpose: The run's progress along the stepper (teal to pink to orange).

shadows.name: kept-frame
shadows.value: canvas shadowBlur 12, breach red, 1.5px stroke, 4px radius
shadows.purpose: The frame around the baseline's never-erased values.

shadows.name: tooltip
shadows.purpose: The tooltip, the one floating element.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Every CSS transition: readout fade and 3px rise (0.35s), check ticks and stop colours (0.3s), gate lighting (0.5s), stepper fill (0.5s), discovery line (0.35s).

motion.name: page-load
motion.purpose: A lane's Extract time is its recorded page loads x 0.045s; its values leave staggered across it.

motion.name: flight
motion.purpose: One value from cell to lock (to 40%), beside the gate to lane level (to 74%), level into the pipe (to 100%); trail = last 9% of the path at half alpha.

motion.name: move
motion.purpose: Values easing from one stretch to the next (ease-in-out).

motion.name: steps
motion.value: Gate 1.35s; Acquire 1.5s (beam 1.25s); Extract slowest lane + 1.0s; Score 1.6s; Export 1.6s; Erase 1.9s
motion.purpose: How long each presenter step plays.

motion.name: rule-lamps
motion.purpose: The seven lamps lighting in turn.

motion.name: card-flip
motion.purpose: A patient-card cell flipping from dash to value.

motion.name: token-scramble
motion.purpose: The token chip resolving out of hex noise.

motion.name: erase-dissolve
motion.value: alpha 1 - ease(f), radius to 45%, rise 7px over the 0.9s move
motion.purpose: A lane with an erase date dissolving.

motion.name: stepping
motion.value: Space / Right / PageDown next; Left / PageUp back; Home; End; 1-3 briefing; J job
motion.purpose: A second press lands the step in progress.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No flights, trails, breach pulse, flips, scramble, beacon or transitions; every state and reading still shown.

canvas.sprite: radial gradient: white 0, colour 16%, colour .42 at 38%, transparent 100%; cached per colour
canvas.composite: lighter for particles; source-over for matrix, afterimages and kept block
canvas.density: glow scale clamp(sqrt(36/n), 0.2, 1); halo 3.4r, 2.3r above 120 values; in flight 3.4r
canvas.matrix: cell 74% of pitch, 1.6px radius; dim .34, lit .82; read hollow fill .14 + outline .7; ours/model ring 1.4px lane colour; module gap 7px
canvas.patient-row: white outline .9 alpha, 1.2px, 3px radius, white pointer triangle
canvas.afterimage: disc at .16 in category colour; red ring .65 for out of purpose or raw id; dim white diamond .32 for a token
canvas.breach-halo: red sprite 5.2r (3.2r above 120 values), pulse .2 sin(4t)
canvas.token: white diamond 1.5r with white sprite at .45
canvas.kept: squares 0.8 pitch at .9, raw identifiers red, one red frame

narrative.overview:
Portal version 2 is the recorded pipeline run drawn as a live data stream on a night ground. The hospital is not a picture of a hospital; it is what the hospital holds, 20 patients by 34 fields, 680 values, each a small rounded cell in the colour of its DPDP data category. For the chosen job, every value a technique reads leaves its cell as a point of light, funnels through the gate's lock, and travels down its lane through four stretches: Extract, Score, Export, Erase. Every glow on the stage is a value or a verdict. Breaches happen in the stream, where the room can see them: a red halo on a value out of purpose, a raw identifier leaving red, the baseline's never-erased values sitting in one red frame at the end of its pipe.

The chrome around the stream is a dark product console in the register the user named (Linear, Vercel, Datadog live tail, Stripe data-flow heroes): hairline borders, faint glass panels, a status pill, metric labels over tabular numerals, a segmented control, one white key. The chrome is quiet so the data can be loud. It is one offline, self-contained file; Inter is embedded (variable WOFF2, OFL) by a user-approved exception to the Portal brief's no-web-fonts rule, so the file stays single and works with no network.

Density is presentation density for a projected 1366x768 laptop: four fixed frame rows, nothing scrolls on a laptop, figures large enough to read from the back of the room, words held to labels; the presenter explains.
keyCharacteristics: Night ground with two faint radial tints; all colour on stage is data.
Three lane accents (teal ours, pink the AI model, orange the baseline), six category colours, breach red, lit yellow for "here", white for tokens.
One typeface, Inter, at weights 400 / 550 / 600 / 650 / 700, tabular numerals throughout.
A canvas particle layer over a DOM frame; the canvas never carries text.
Every step is a state the presenter lands on; motion only travels between states.

rules.name: The Honest Token Rule
rules.body: Tokens come from the project's pseudonymiser with a fixed display key per technique; two lanes never show the same token for one patient, and the export audit matches digits only within one field.

rules.name: The 13px Floor Rule
rules.body: Everything the panel reads is at least 0.8125rem, 13px at the 1366 root; only key caps, stepper labels and tooltips sit at 0.75rem.

rules.name: The Light Is Data Rule
rules.body: A glow on the stage is a value, a verdict or the current position. Particles, rule lamps and the raw chip glow; panels, cards and labels never do. Lit yellow's glow marks "here" (gate, current stretch divider, current stop) and nothing else. The one exception on chrome is the Next key's soft white lift, because it is the control pressed every step.

rules.name: The Lane Owns Its Hue Rule
rules.body: Teal, pink and orange name a lane wherever they appear: roundel, figures, pipe glow, cell ring, stepper fill. A lane colour is never used for a state that is not that lane's.

rules.name: The Red Is A Breach Rule
rules.body: Breach red appears only where a value, rule, identifier or retention breaks the purpose. A neutral warning or an emphasis never borrows it.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Inter for every word and figure; the only other face is the mono identifier chip. Inter is embedded, so the projected room sees what was designed.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number on the page uses tabular figures and a fixed-width column (KPI columns are 5.25rem minimum, right-aligned) so a counter climbing from 0 to 680 never shifts its neighbours.

rules.name: The Glass Not Card Rule
rules.body: Panels are glass over the ground with a hairline; none is lifted by a dark shadow. The tooltip is the one floating element.

dos: Do draw every value from the recorded run: a lane's flight time is its recorded page loads at 0.045s each, and its particles are the cells that run read.
Do keep the category colour on a value from cell to particle to afterimage; only tokenisation (white diamond) or a raw identifier at the never-erased block (red) changes it.
Do route every value through the gate's lock and keep it at pipe height near the lanes.
Do keep KPI figures at 1.5rem and readout figures at 1.25rem, tabular, in fixed-width columns.
Do scale everything from the root clamp in rem so the projected 1366x768 frame and a 1920 screen keep the same composition.
Do keep the file single and offline: Inter embedded, canvas, SVG and CSS only.
donts: Don't put glow, gradients or colour on chrome that does not carry a value, a verdict or the current position .
Don't use a lane colour for anything but its lane, or breach red for anything but a breach.
Don't show a raw identifier, contact detail or quasi-identifier; the patient's record number and name are masked and the builder audits the output.
Don't add explanatory prose to the stage; labels and figures only, the presenter explains.
Don't let a dense lane white out: keep the density scaling and the smaller halo above 120 values.
**Don't** set anything the panel reads below 0.8125rem (13px at the 1366 root).
